messages:
Ravi K: Getting a support ticket where the user copied the quickstart curl and hit a 401 'insufficient_scope' + Windows quoting failure.
Lina Z: Can you paste what they ran?
Ravi K: From README: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-redwood-1","input":"test"}'
```
Carlos M: Two separate DX issues: (1) docs don't mention required key scopes (POSTs need inference.write), (2) single-quote/cmd.exe quoting breaks on Windows. Also some samples still use REDWOOD_KEY env var.
Lina Z: Quick fixes: add an "Auth troubleshooting" note above curl (mention inference.write and service tokens), add a Windows example using %REDWOOD_API_KEY% and double quotes, and standardize env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY across samples.
Carlos M: Also add a one-line pointer in Python quickstart showing how to configure retries/refresh for rotated tokens (parity with Node). Minimal snippet is fine.
Docs Lint Bot: docs-ci: found inconsistent env var names across samples; spellcheck ok.
Ravi K: I'll open a micro-PR to (A) add scope note and example comment, (B) include Windows curl snippet, (C) fix env var name in sample app, and (D) add changelog line at top: "2026-03-15: clarified auth scopes, env var names, and retry guidance."
Lina Z: Send my PR review for the Python retry blurb. Once merged, add a small smoke test in samples CI to catch quoting/env var regressions.
Carlos M: Thanks. Leaving thread open until PR merged. :thumbsup:
